zh.title: 美國航空因應9月減班 向1205名空服員提供無薪假
zh.summary: 美國航空因應9月計畫實施的航班減少，向1,205名空服員提供無薪假安排。相關調整主要受到秋季班表提前實施以及航空燃油成本上漲影響，並導致美國航空旗下最繁忙的樞紐機場出現4%的人力調整。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，美國航空（American Airlines）在預計於9月份實施航班削減的背景下，正向旗下1,205名空服員提供無薪假（unpaid leave）選項。
這項人力調配措施，主要是受到秋季營運班表的提前實施，以及航空燃油成本持續上升的影響。航空公司隨之做出相應的營運與人力調整。
受上述因素共同作用，美國航空在其最繁忙的數個樞紐機場，針對整體人力實施了約4%的規模調整，以因應9月份的航班排程變化。

en.title: American Airlines Offers 1,205 Flight Attendants Unpaid Leave Amid September Cuts
en.summary: American Airlines is offering unpaid leave to 1,205 flight attendants ahead of planned flight reductions in September, according to report details published by Simple Flying. The operational decision stems from an earlier fall flight schedule combined with rising jet fuel costs, prompting a 4% workforce adjustment across the airline's busiest hub airports. The voluntary leave measures allow the carrier to manage crew staffing levels in response to reduced schedule capacity overall.
body: According to a news report published by Simple Flying, American Airlines is offering unpaid leave to 1,205 flight attendants in response to upcoming flight reductions planned for September.
The carrier's decision to offer unpaid leave comes as an earlier fall flight schedule takes effect alongside rising jet fuel costs across its network.

Driven by the combination of an earlier fall schedule and higher jet fuel costs, American Airlines is implementing a 4% workforce adjustment across its busiest hub airports. This operational adjustment helps the airline align its crew staffing with reduced flight capacity at its primary hub locations during September.

zh.title: 漢光演習憲兵於台北捷運地下路線演練部隊機動與運補
zh.summary: 漢光演習進入第5天，憲兵指揮部於8月9日凌晨聯合台北市政府、台北捷運公司及台北市警察局，在台北運用捷運地下路線實施部隊機動與後勤補給演練。演練並導入共同作戰圖像與通信備援系統，以磨練部隊發揮公共設施效能，強化城鎮防衛韌性。
body: 漢光演習進入第5天，憲兵指揮部於2026年8月9日凌晨在台北運用捷運地下路線，實施部隊機動及後勤補給任務演練。演練過程統合責任區內主戰、守備與後勤支援部隊，並聯合台北市政府、台北大眾捷運股份有限公司及台北市警察局共同執行。
演練期間，憲兵部隊導入共同作戰圖像與通信備援等通資訊系統。憲兵指揮部表示，此次演練結合戰場景況，旨在磨練部隊依戰術需要整合並發揮既有公共設施與系統效能，遂行防衛作戰任務，建構城鎮防衛作戰韌性。

en.title: Military Police Conduct Troop Transport Exercise in Taipei Metro System
en.summary: During the fifth day of the Han Kuang exercise, Taiwan Military Police Command conducted a troop movement and logistical supply exercise in Taipei using underground metro lines in the early morning of August 9. The joint drill was carried out in coordination with the Taipei City Government, Taipei Rapid Transit Corporation, and Taipei City Police Department. The exercise incorporated common operational picture and backup communication systems, aiming to train forces in utilizing existing public infrastructure to enhance urban defense resilience.
body: On the fifth day of the Han Kuang exercise, Taiwan Military Police Command conducted a movement and logistical supply mission exercise in Taipei during the early morning of August 9, 2026, utilizing underground metro lines. The exercise integrated main combat, garrison, and logistical support units within the responsibility area, in coordination with the Taipei City Government, Taipei Rapid Transit Corporation, and Taipei City Police Department.

During the exercise, units incorporated common operational picture and backup communication systems. Military Police Command stated that the drill was combined with battlefield scenarios to train units in integrating and leveraging existing public infrastructure and system capabilities according to tactical requirements, thereby strengthening urban defense operation resilience.
